reachDefinition: 4-neighbour walkable components with no tile on the render boundary or beside omitted fixed ground; cropped paths leaving the view are treated as reachable. Cyan walkability-tree paths link boundary samples and markers; orange = isolated.
note: Land shares and axial runs sample chunk centres. Rectangles include both endpoints. Fixed authored chunks are grey hatching and excluded from tile/camp/place metrics. Entities white; sites magenta; lamp stones yellow; rumours orange; places red.
